column1: # ppsm-services.tsv - what each listening socket IS, for the PPSM CLSA (backlog 6a.22).
# HAND-MAINTAINED, and the only hand-written input to ppsm.py. Everything else - what is
# listening, where, the firewall state - is measured every 15 minutes by `monitoring.sh facts`.
# Built 2026-09-19 from the listeners all eight machines actually reported, not from memory.
#   port      the port, or * for a service whose port is ephemeral (random at each start)
#   process   as ss reports it. THE KERNEL TRUNCATES NAMES TO 15 CHARACTERS - the libvirt
#             exporter is "prometheus-libv", the contracts server is "contracts-airga".
#   cal       the EXACT service name in the PPSM CAL at that port and protocol, or - when the
#             CAL has no entry (then it needs a local CLSA entry and AO approval)
#   purpose   one line, for the CLSA. Firewall justifications live in stig-tailor.sh ufw_rules();
#             this says what the service is, not why the port is open.
#   clsa      ONLY where cal is - and the port is reachable off the machine: the proposed local
#             CLSA service name WITHOUT the ORG prefix (ppsm.py adds «PPSM_ORG»-). Written the
#             way the CAL's CLSA sheet names things: VENDOR-PRODUCT-FUNCTION, upper case.
#   risk      same rows: what the service exposes, how, and what limits it - the paragraph the
#             AO decides on. Facts only; each was checked against the config when written.
# A listener that matches no row is reported as UNIDENTIFIED - add a row, or remove the service.

column7: Plain-HTTP API of the Ubuntu Pro air-gapped contracts server; answers entitlement requests for every machine's `pro` client. contracts-airgapped has no bind-address option, only --port, so the socket binds all interfaces. Off-host access is dropped by systemd IPAddressDeny=any / IPAddressAllow=localhost on the unit, and ufw on svc-mgmt-01 has no rule for 8484 - two independent filters. Clients reach it only through nginx TLS on 443, proxied to 127.0.0.1:8484. The entry is requested because the socket is bound, not because it is reachable: approve as host-local only

column5: Prometheus node-exporter - host metrics, scraped only by svc-obs-01
column7: Plain HTTP, no authentication (no --web.config.file is set). Read-only: host CPU, memory, disk, network counters, systemd unit states, and the enclave compliance facts - which include each machine's listening ports and ufw rules. No write path. Bound to the machine's enclave address, not all interfaces; ufw admits only svc-obs-01. Residual risk: metrics cross the enclave LAN in clear. Available mitigation, not yet built: TLS via --web.config.file with a certificate from the enclave CA

column5: Prometheus libvirt exporter - per-guest metrics on hypervisors, scraped only by svc-obs-01
column7: Plain HTTP, no authentication. Read-only: per-guest state, vCPU, memory, disk and interface counters, and guest names, from libvirt on the hypervisors. The HTTP endpoint serves metrics only. Bound to the host's enclave address; ufw admits only svc-obs-01. Residual risk: guest inventory and counters cross the enclave LAN in clear. Available mitigation, not yet built: TLS with a certificate from the enclave CA
